```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(knitr)
})
if (requireNamespace("ComplexHeatmap", quietly = TRUE)) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ComplexHeatmap))
}
if (is.null(params$report_rds) || !nzchar(params$report_rds) || !file.exists(params$report_rds)) {
  stop("comparative report is missing report_rds.")
}
report <- readRDS(params$report_rds)

print_plot <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(invisible(NULL))
  if (inherits(x, "gg") || inherits(x, "Heatmap") || inherits(x, "patchwork")) {
    print(x)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  if (inherits(x, "HeatmapList")) {
    ComplexHeatmap::draw(x)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

# Comparison

```{r comparison-definition, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf(
  "Parent method: **%s**. Cells are grouped by `%s` (%s groups). The object has %s cells from %s samples. Pseudobulk mode: %s.\n",
  report$method,
  report$grouping_variable,
  report$n_groups,
  report$n_cells,
  report$n_samples,
  if (isTRUE(report$pseudobulk)) "yes" else "no"
))
```

# Embedding

```{r dimplots, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
if (!is.null(report$dimplots$clusters)) {
  print_plot(report$dimplots$clusters)
}
if (!is.null(report$dimplots$condition)) {
  print_plot(report$dimplots$condition)
}
if (!is.null(report$dimplots$code)) {
  print_plot(report$dimplots$code)
}
```

# Composition

```{r composition, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
comp <- report$composition
if (!is.null(comp$globalcomposition$hmprop)) {
  print_plot(comp$globalcomposition$hmprop)
}
if (!is.null(comp$composition_plots)) {
  for (nm in names(comp$composition_plots)) {
    print_plot(comp$composition_plots[[nm]])
  }
}
```

```{r composition-table, results='asis'}
comp <- report$composition
if (is.data.frame(comp$composition_results) && nrow(comp$composition_results)) {
  print(knitr::kable(utils::head(comp$composition_results, 30)))
}
```

# Differential expression

```{r de-table, results='asis'}
de <- report$de_top
if (is.null(de) || !is.data.frame(de) || !nrow(de)) {
  cat("Differential expression returned no genes.\n")
} else {
  cat("Top genes per group by absolute log fold change.\n\n")
  cols <- intersect(
    c("label", "cluster", "gene_symbol", "gene", "logFC", "avg_log2FC", "PValue", "p_val", "FDR", "p_val_adj"),
    colnames(de)
  )
  show <- if (length(cols)) de[, cols, drop = FALSE] else de
  print(knitr::kable(utils::head(show, 40)))
}
```

# Milo

```{r milo, results='asis', fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
milo <- report$milo
if (is.null(milo)) {
  cat("Milo was not run.\n")
} else {
  print_plot(milo$size_plot)
  if (is.list(milo$comparisons)) {
    for (nm in names(milo$comparisons)) {
      one <- milo$comparisons[[nm]]
      cat("\n\n## ", nm, "\n\n", sep = "")
      if (isTRUE(one$skipped)) {
        cat("Skipped: ", one$skip_reason, "\n", sep = "")
      } else {
        print_plot(one$beeswarm)
        print_plot(one$graph)
        print_plot(one$ma)
      }
    }
  }
}
```

# Pathways

```{r pathways, results='asis', fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
pw <- report$pathways
if (is.null(pw)) {
  cat("Pathway analysis was not run.\n")
} else if (is.data.frame(pw$pathway_results)) {
  cat("GSEA summary dot plots. Per-cluster tables are written under the pathway output directory.\n\n")
  plots <- pw$pathwaysummplots_comps
  if (is.list(plots)) {
    for (lab in names(plots)) {
      cat("\n\n## ", lab, "\n\n", sep = "")
      cats <- plots[[lab]]
      if (inherits(cats, "gg")) {
        print_plot(cats)
      } else if (is.list(cats)) {
        for (cat_name in names(cats)) {
          cat("\n\n### ", cat_name, "\n\n", sep = "")
          print_plot(cats[[cat_name]])
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

# ORA

```{r ora, results='asis'}
ora <- report$ora
if (is.null(ora)) {
  cat("ORA was not run.\n")
} else if (is.data.frame(ora) && nrow(ora)) {
  print(knitr::kable(utils::head(ora, 30)))
} else {
  cat("ORA returned no rows.\n")
}
```
